# SCI-NOI v0.1 r0.5 Normative Definitions
Module identity: `SCI-NOI_NORMATIVE_DEFINITIONS v0.1/r0.5`
Scientific owner: Grant Wilson. Status: proposed final; not frozen.

## D-001 Operations and route
GEN, UNC, and STD are separate. The ordinary route inserts one active detector sign at the exact PTC-to-frozen-MAP boundary; NOI owns design and realization, MAP owns conforming frozen arithmetic.
## D-002 Fixed method
Every consequential adjacent state is fixed; relearning or reselection creates another method and ensemble.
## D-003 Population and scope
Base v0.1 has one ensemble per exact observation and TolTEC array. Complete, active, zero-mass, zero-total, singleton, and ambiguous states retain their approved typed dispositions.
## D-004 Selected design
Independent symmetric candidates are first-accepted under every exact active-stratum condition, with positive cap, fail-closed exhaustion, replacement, valid duplicate draws, separate complement orbits, and no forced pair.
## D-005 Disabled and enabled
`not_requested` has no requested GEN method, eligibility proposition, or assignment design. `explicitly_disabled` retains exact request/effective-plan identity plus disabling owner, policy, and cause, but no resolved assignment design. Both have `N_requested=0` and no members or downstream product; they are not aliases. Enabled means a positive integer request and complete resolution; a smaller ensemble is never success.
## D-006 Exact arithmetic
Design quantities use canonical reduced arbitrary-precision rational pairs and exact integer cross multiplication. Every `a_pi` rational is a lossless encoding of the exact frozen MAP contribution bound to its product/generation, `G_pi`, coefficient family/generation/payload, representation source, and digest. It governs NOI design only and never replaces MAP arithmetic.
## D-007 Joint law
The scientific randomization measure, ideal candidate-bit/key-selection law, and deterministic replay map are distinct. Before key resolution the declared ideal model is `epsilon_b iid ~ Uniform(A)`, where `A` is the canonical product of stratum-admitted sets. After key binding, replay is deterministic and establishes identity, not statistical independence or generator adequacy.
## D-008 Source-bearing target
The fixed parent may contain source and residual structure. The ensemble is not a source-free null, repeated physical noise, or calibrated tail law.
## D-009 Initial UNC
The primary product is `conditional_detector_sign_randomization_marginal_second_moment`. Known zero target mean makes it equal to target-law marginal variance; it is not displayed as map/noise variance or total uncertainty.
## D-010 Atomic UNC membership
Realized base UNC implies `A_UNC=B_resolved` and equality of positive requested, resolved, completed, and admitted counts. Every resolved member completes, passes assignment-ignorable policy, shares the common domain, and enters the estimator. Failed or unavailable states retain factual possibly unequal counts and causes; no survivor normalization or estimator exists.
## D-011 Effective information
Effective Monte Carlo information is estimator-, target-, domain-, dependence-, and calculation-specific. It is not inferred from counts, uniqueness, or ranks.
## D-012 STD response
`zeta_cond` is nonlinear and data-dependent because numerator and scale descend from the same observed parent. A fixed-scale derivative is not the full procedure response.
## D-013 Ownership and profiles
GEN owns completion; NOI owns use policy; VAL binds/evaluates. Immutable r0.18 profiles remain exact; changed r0.5 uses are unavailable until approved and bound successors exist.
## D-014 Claim ceiling
No reciprocal ordinary product, significance, detection, conformity, random-generator validation, calibration, performance, readiness, freeze, or production claim is supplied.
## D-015 Design-ignorable member selection
Every binding predicate in `R_b` is fixed before assignment or invariant under `epsilon_b` and `M_b`. Assignment-dependent diagnostics are advisory only. A required output-dependent gate defines a different selection-conditioned method; base v0.1 becomes unavailable rather than silently changing its target law.
## D-016 Conditional scientific freeze
Exact unavailable numerical parents, routes, profile authority, full STD response, implementation conformity, and empirical validation block their dependent products and claims but do not prevent conditional freeze of a coherent implementation-independent contract.
